items.reason: Although pkg/server/wire.go:374-375 retains the provider and binding, pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/impl.go:36-43 removes the injected AnonStore dependency and constructs it directly with cfg.AnonymousDeviceLimit. The API also receives that store directly at impl.go:61, leaving the registered store provider unreachable; [Wire’s dependency solver](https://github.com/google/wire/blob/v0.5.0/internal/wire/analyze.go#L87-L164) therefore never requests its int64 argument, so the claimed generation/build failure does not follow.
